theorems.name: Weil zeta function for curves
theorems.name_zh: 曲线的 Weil zeta 函数
theorems.applicable_when: 计算光滑射影曲线在有限域或其扩张上的点数
theorems.reduces: 把 O(q^n) 逐点枚举降为计算 2g 维 Frobenius 特征多项式，其中 g 是 genus
invariant_hints: point counts over small base fields
verification_hints: check the final count against the Hasse-Weil bound
verify consistency with counts over small base fields
confirm the extension-field count follows the Frobenius eigenvalue recurrence
theorems.sage_hint: C = Curve(x^3*y + y^3*z + z^3*x, ProjectiveSpace(GF(p), 2, 'x,y,z')); pts = C.count_points(g); # then Newton identities to get Frobenius poly and N_target
preferred_recipe: verify curve is smooth and compute genus g
build C = Curve(f, ProjectiveSpace(GF(p), 2, 'x,y,z')) over the BASE field GF(p)
call C.count_points(g) to get [N_1, ..., N_g] over GF(p), GF(p^2), ..., GF(p^g)
derive Frobenius char poly P(T) via Newton identities from s_n = p^n + 1 - N_n
compute N_target = q^target + 1 - sum(alpha_i^target) where alpha_i are roots of P(T)
avoid_patterns: do not manually enumerate points with list comprehensions over GF(q^n) for n > 1
do not use rational_points() — use count_points(n) instead
do not construct ProjectiveSpace over extension fields GF(p^n) for n > 4

theorems.name: Hasse-Weil bound
theorems.applicable_when: 估计有限域上曲线点数的范围
theorems.reduces: 给出 |#C(F_q) - q - 1| <= 2g*sqrt(q) 的界，无需精确计算
verification_hints: check the final count against the Hasse-Weil bound

theorems.name: Lefschetz trace formula
theorems.applicable_when: 通过 Frobenius 作用的迹计算有限域上簇的点数
theorems.reduces: #X(F_q) = sum (-1)^i Tr(Frob | H^i)，把点数化为线性代数
prerequisites: etale cohomology groups or Frobenius eigenvalues
theorems.sage_hint: For curves: use zeta function; for higher dim: may need explicit cohomology

theorems.name: Klein quartic and PSL(2,7) symmetry
theorems.name_zh: Klein 四次曲线与 PSL(2,7) 对称性
theorems.applicable_when: 处理 Klein 四次曲线 x^3y+y^3z+z^3x=0 或其约化
theorems.reduces: genus=3 的曲线，自同构群为 PSL(2,7)（168阶），Jacobian 可能分解为椭圆曲线的乘积
prerequisites: whether curve is smooth mod p
invariant_hints: whether the curve is smooth mod p
verification_hints: verify the curve remains smooth in the target characteristic
check the computed Weil polynomial against small-field point counts
confirm any Jacobian decomposition is compatible with the final point count
theorems.sage_hint: Check smoothness; compute genus; for point counts use C.count_points(3) over small F_p then derive Frobenius poly via Newton identities
preferred_recipe: confirm smoothness in target characteristic p
genus = 3 for Klein quartic; need only N_1, N_2, N_3 over base field GF(p)
use Weil zeta function recipe: C.count_points(3) then Newton identities
avoid_patterns: do not attempt brute-force point enumeration over large extension fields

theorems.name: Jacobian decomposition into elliptic curves
theorems.applicable_when: 曲线的 Jacobian 可分解为椭圆曲线的乘积时，简化点数计算
theorems.reduces: 把 genus g 曲线的 zeta 函数分解为 g 个椭圆曲线的 zeta 函数之积
invariant_hints: trace of Frobenius on each factor
verification_hints: check that the factored zeta polynomial reproduces the final point count
verify each elliptic-curve factor is compatible with the claimed isogeny decomposition
theorems.sage_hint: J = C.jacobian(); or compute zeta polynomial and factor it

theorems.name: Hasse bound for elliptic curves
theorems.name_zh: 椭圆曲线的 Hasse 界
theorems.applicable_when: 估计或计算椭圆曲线在有限域上的点数
theorems.reduces: |#E(F_p) - p - 1| <= 2*sqrt(p)，且 #E(F_{p^n}) 可由 a_p 递推
verification_hints: check the elliptic-curve count against the Hasse bound
verify extension-field counts satisfy the Frobenius recurrence

theorems.name: Mordell-Weil theorem
theorems.applicable_when: 确定有理数域上椭圆曲线的有限生成阿贝尔群结构
theorems.reduces: E(Q) ≅ Z^r × T，只需计算秩 r 和扭子群 T

theorems.name: Quadratic reciprocity
theorems.applicable_when: 判断 a 是否为模 p 的二次剩余
theorems.reduces: 把二次剩余判定化为 Legendre 符号计算

theorems.name: Artin reciprocity / class field theory
theorems.name_zh: Artin 互反律 / 类域论
theorems.applicable_when: 判断素数在数域扩张中的分裂类型，或证明分裂条件等价于某种算术条件
theorems.reduces: 素数 p 在 K/Q 中的分裂类型由 p 在某个类群中的像决定

theorems.name: Chebotarev density theorem
theorems.applicable_when: 确定满足某种分裂条件的素数的密度
theorems.reduces: 密度 = |C|/|G|，其中 C 是 Galois 群中的共轭类
theorems.sage_hint: K.galois_group(); use galois_group_chebotarev tool for high degree

theorems.name: Dedekind zeta function
theorems.applicable_when: 计算数域的解析不变量或素数分布
theorems.reduces: 把数域中的素理想计数化为 L 函数的解析性质

theorems.name: Class number formula
theorems.applicable_when: 计算数域的类数或验证类数相关性质
theorems.reduces: 类数由判别式、regulator、单位群等解析量决定

theorems.name: Dedekind's theorem on prime ideal factorization
theorems.applicable_when: 计算素数在数域整数环中的分解类型
theorems.reduces: p 的分解由最小多项式 mod p 的因式分解决定

theorems.name: Representation of primes by binary quadratic forms
theorems.applicable_when: 判断素数能否表示为某种二次型
theorems.reduces: p = a²+nb² 等价于 p 在 Q(√-n) 中分裂且满足类群条件

theorems.name: Burnside's lemma (Cauchy-Frobenius)
theorems.applicable_when: 在群作用下计数不等价对象（如 up to scaling, up to rotation）
theorems.reduces: |X/G| = (1/|G|) * sum |Fix(g)|，把等价类计数化为不动点计数
prerequisites: group G acting on set X
fixed point counts for each group element
theorems.sage_hint: Compute fixed points for each group element; sum and divide by |G|

theorems.name: Polya enumeration theorem
theorems.applicable_when: 在对称群作用下计数着色方案或组合结构
theorems.reduces: 用循环指标多项式统一计算

theorems.name: Sylow theorems
theorems.applicable_when: 分析有限群的 p-子群结构
theorems.reduces: Sylow p-子群存在，个数 ≡ 1 mod p 且整除 |G|

theorems.name: Chinese Remainder Theorem
theorems.applicable_when: 求解联立同余方程组或分解模运算
theorems.reduces: 把模 mn 的计算分解为模 m 和模 n 的独立计算

theorems.name: Hensel's lemma
theorems.applicable_when: 将模 p 的解提升到模 p^k 的解
theorems.reduces: 只需找到模 p 的简单根，即可自动提升到任意精度
theorems.sage_hint: Solve mod p first, then lift using Hensel

theorems.name: Euler product formula for zeta/L-functions
theorems.name_zh: zeta/L 函数的 Euler 乘积
theorems.applicable_when: 将 zeta 或 L 函数表示为素数上的乘积
theorems.reduces: 把无穷级数化为素数上的局部因子之积
theorems.sage_hint: Use symbolic zeta or L-function computation

theorems.name: Fundamental theorem of Galois theory
theorems.applicable_when: 在 Galois 扩张中建立子群与中间域的对应
theorems.reduces: 子群 H ↔ 不动域 K^H，把域论问题化为群论问题

theorems.name: Riemann-Roch theorem
theorems.applicable_when: 计算曲线上线性系统的维数
theorems.reduces: l(D) - l(K-D) = deg(D) - g + 1
theorems.sage_hint: C.genus(); divisor computations via function field

theorems.name: Fermat's little theorem
theorems.applicable_when: 简化模素数的幂运算
theorems.reduces: a^(p-1) ≡ 1 (mod p)，指数可模 p-1 化简

theorems.name: Waring's problem / circle method
theorems.applicable_when: 将整数表示为 k 次幂之和
theorems.reduces: 用解析方法（圆法）估计表示数
theorems.sage_hint: Brute force for small cases; analytic for asymptotics
